modified_caption: Training Loss vs. Steps for Each Model Type by Model Size with a Data Size of 20 million. The loss trends for 10 million and 20 million datasets are similar. The ChemBERTa Small 20M model exhibits the steepest decline in training loss, reaching approximately 0.15 at 440k steps. ChemLLaMA Medium 20M consistently outperforms ChemBART Medium 20M, achieving the lowest loss of all models at 0.01. The ChemBART Small 20M model shows a slower rate of decline compared to ChemLLaMA Small 20M, stabilizing at around 0.25 at 440k steps.

modifications.claim: The ChemBERTa Small 20M model exhibits the steepest decline in training loss, reaching approximately 0.15 at 440k steps.
modifications.reality: The ChemBERTa Small 20M model does not exhibit the steepest decline; it remains the highest loss overall, stabilizing around 0.28 at 440k steps.

modifications.claim: ChemLLaMA Medium 20M consistently outperforms ChemBART Medium 20M, achieving the lowest loss of all models at 0.01.
modifications.reality: ChemLLaMA Medium 20M does not achieve the lowest loss; it stabilizes around 0.02, similar to ChemBART Medium 20M.

modifications.claim: The ChemBART Small 20M model shows a slower rate of decline compared to ChemLLaMA Small 20M, stabilizing at around 0.25 at 440k steps.
modifications.reality: ChemBART Small 20M does not stabilize at 0.25; it reaches approximately 0.02 at 440k steps, similar to ChemLLaMA Small 20M.
